name: @dangbt/pro-ui
description: React UI component library built on React Aria Components + Tailwind CSS v4

components.name: ProTable
components.description: Advanced data table with server-side pagination, sorting, filtering, column toggling, column pinning, row selection, bulk actions, and expandable rows. Supports both server-side (request) and client-side (dataSource) modes.

props.name: request
props.description: Server-side data fetcher. Mutually exclusive with dataSource. Held in a ref — replacing the function does not refetch, pass external filters via params.

props.name: params
props.description: External filters owned by the page (search box, tabs, URL query). Merged into the request argument and refetches on change, resetting to page 1. Compared by value, so an inline object literal is safe.

props.name: dataSource
props.description: Client-side static data. Mutually exclusive with request.

props.name: toolBarRender
props.description: Render extra buttons in the toolbar

props.name: search
props.description: Set false to hide search form

props.name: bulkActions
props.description: Actions shown when rows are selected

props.name: rowClassName
props.description: Add CSS classes to rows conditionally

props.name: onRow
props.type: (record: T, index: number) => { onClick?; onDoubleClick?; onContextMenu? }

props.name: persistColumnVisibility
props.description: Persist show/hide column state to localStorage. true = auto-derived key; string = explicit key; false = disabled

components.name: ProForm
components.import: ProForm, ProFormInput, ProFormSelect, ProFormDatePicker, ProFormTextarea, ProFormNumberField, ProFormCheckbox, ProFormSwitch, ProFormRadioGroup, ProFormComboBox, ProFormAsyncSelect
components.description: Form builder with Zod validation, grid layout, and a rich set of field components. Uses react-hook-form under the hood.

props.name: loading
props.description: Show loading state on submit button

components.name: Layout
components.description: App shell with collapsible sidebar navigation, header slot, and content area. Handles responsive mobile drawer automatically.

components.name: Modal
components.description: Accessible modal dialog with focus trap, backdrop, and animation. Uses React Aria DialogTrigger.

components.name: Drawer
components.description: Slide-in panel from left, right, or bottom. Ideal for filter panels, mobile nav, detail views.

components.name: Popover
components.description: Floating popover panel anchored to a trigger element. Good for contextual menus and info panels.

components.name: Toast
components.description: Global toast notifications. Mount ToastProvider once at app root, call toast() anywhere.

components.name: ThemeProvider
components.description: Context provider for light/dark/system theme. Persists to localStorage, listens to system preference. Toggle class .dark on <html> element.

props.name: defaultTheme
props.description: Initial theme if nothing in localStorage

components.name: Statistic
components.description: KPI card showing a metric value with optional trend indicator (up/down/neutral), prefix, suffix, and formatter.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Content before value (e.g. icon or currency symbol)

components.name: Steps
components.description: Multi-step progress indicator. Supports horizontal/vertical orientation, error state, clickable steps, and custom icons.

props.name: items
props.description: Array of step definitions ({ title, description?, status?, icon? })

props.name: current
props.description: Zero-based index of the current step

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when a step is clicked (makes steps clickable)

components.name: Empty
components.description: Empty state placeholder with optional custom image, title, description, and action button.

components.name: Button
components.description: Accessible button with variants (solid, outline, ghost, danger), sizes, loading state, and icon support. Built on React Aria.
components.example:
import { Button } from '@dangbt/pro-ui'
import { Plus, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react'

// Variants
<Button variant="primary" onPress={handleSave}>Save</Button>
<Button variant="secondary" onPress={handleCancel}>Cancel</Button>
<Button variant="ghost" onPress={handleEdit}>Edit</Button>
<Button variant="danger" onPress={handleDelete}>Delete</Button>

// With icon
<Button variant="primary" onPress={handleAdd}>
  <Plus size={16} /> Add Item
</Button>

// Loading state
<Button variant="primary" loading={isSubmitting} type="submit">
  Submit
</Button>

components.name: Input
components.description: Text input field with label, description, error message, prefix/suffix icons. Built on React Aria.

props.name: type
props.description: HTML input type (text, email, password, etc.)

components.example:
import { Input } from '@dangbt/pro-ui'
import { Search, Mail } from 'lucide-react'

<Input label="Email" type="email" placeholder="you@example.com" prefix={<Mail size={14} />} />
<Input label="Search" placeholder="Search..." prefix={<Search size={14} />} />
<Input label="Name" errorMessage="Name is required" />

components.name: Select
components.description: Accessible dropdown select with keyboard navigation, search, and custom option rendering.
components.example:
import { Select } from '@dangbt/pro-ui'

<Select
  label="Role"
  placeholder="Select a role"
  options={[
    { value: 'admin', label: 'Administrator' },
    { value: 'user', label: 'User' },
    { value: 'viewer', label: 'Viewer' },
  ]}
/>

components.name: Badge
components.description: Small status label with color variants for indicating states.
components.example:
import { Badge } from '@dangbt/pro-ui'

<Badge variant="success">Active</Badge>
<Badge variant="danger">Inactive</Badge>
<Badge variant="warning">Pending</Badge>
<Badge variant="info">Draft</Badge>

components.name: Card
components.description: Container card with optional header, footer, padding, and shadow.
components.example:
import { Card } from '@dangbt/pro-ui' Account Settings}>

Manage your account preferences here.

components.name: Menu
components.description: Dropdown action menu with keyboard navigation, sections, and icons.
components.example:
import { Menu, Button } from '@dangbt/pro-ui'
import { DialogTrigger } from 'react-aria-components'
import { MoreHorizontal } from 'lucide-react'

<DialogTrigger>
  <Button variant="ghost" size="sm"><MoreHorizontal size={16} /></Button>
  <Menu
    items={[
      { key: 'edit', label: 'Edit', onAction: () => handleEdit() },
      { key: 'duplicate', label: 'Duplicate', onAction: () => handleDuplicate() },
      { key: 'delete', label: 'Delete', danger: true, onAction: () => handleDelete() },
    ]}
  />
</DialogTrigger>

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Accessible tab navigation with keyboard support.
components.example:
import { Tabs, TabList, Tab, TabPanel } from '@dangbt/pro-ui'

<Tabs defaultSelectedKey="overview">
  <TabList>
    <Tab id="overview">Overview</Tab>
    <Tab id="activity">Activity</Tab>
    <Tab id="settings">Settings</Tab>
  </TabList>
  <TabPanel id="overview">Overview content</TabPanel>
  <TabPanel id="activity">Activity content</TabPanel>
  <TabPanel id="settings">Settings content</TabPanel>
</Tabs>

components.name: Alert
components.description: Inline alert message with icon and color variants for info, success, warning, and error states.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: If provided, shows a dismiss button

components.example:
import { Alert } from '@dangbt/pro-ui'

<Alert variant="warning" title="Heads up">
  Your trial expires in 3 days. Upgrade to keep access.
</Alert>
<Alert variant="danger" onDismiss={() => setError(null)}>
  Failed to save changes. Please try again.
</Alert>

components.name: Avatar
components.description: User avatar with image, initials fallback, and size variants. AvatarGroup stacks multiple avatars.

props.name: name
props.description: Name for initials fallback and aria-label

components.example:
import { Avatar, AvatarGroup } from '@dangbt/pro-ui'

<Avatar src="/avatar.jpg" name="John Doe" size="md" />
<Avatar name="Jane Smith" size="lg" /> {/* initials fallback */}

<AvatarGroup max={3}>
  <Avatar name="Alice" />
  <Avatar name="Bob" />
  <Avatar name="Charlie" />
  <Avatar name="Diana" />
</AvatarGroup>

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: Accessible tooltip on hover/focus with customizable placement.

props.name: children
props.description: The element that triggers the tooltip

components.example:
import { Tooltip, Button } from '@dangbt/pro-ui'
import { Info } from 'lucide-react'

<Tooltip content="This field is required for compliance">
  <Button variant="ghost" size="sm"><Info size={14} /></Button>
</Tooltip>

components.name: Spinner
components.description: Loading spinner with size and color variants.
components.example:
import { Spinner } from '@dangbt/pro-ui'

{isLoading && <Spinner size="sm" />}

components.name: Skeleton
components.description: Content placeholder skeleton for loading states.

props.name: className
props.description: Custom classes for size/shape (e.g. w-full h-4 rounded)

props.name: count
props.description: Number of skeleton lines to render

components.example:
import { Skeleton } from '@dangbt/pro-ui' {isLoading ? (
) : }

components.name: Textarea
components.description: Multi-line text input with label, placeholder, and resize support.
components.example:
import { Textarea } from '@dangbt/pro-ui'

<Textarea
  label="Description"
  placeholder="Write a description..."
  rows={4}
/>

components.name: NumberField
components.description: Numeric input with increment/decrement buttons, min/max, and formatting support.
components.example:
import { NumberField } from '@dangbt/pro-ui'

<NumberField label="Quantity" minValue={1} maxValue={100} step={1} />
<NumberField label="Price" minValue={0} step={0.01} />

components.name: SearchField
components.description: Search input with built-in search icon and clear button.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called on Enter or search submit

components.example:
import { SearchField } from '@dangbt/pro-ui'

<SearchField
  placeholder="Search users..."
  onSubmit={(value) => handleSearch(value)}
/>

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: Accessible checkbox with animated checkmark. CheckboxGroup renders a labeled group of checkboxes from an options array.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.description: Accessible radio button group rendered from an options array.

props.name: options
props.type: { value: string; label: string; description?: string; disabled?: boolean }[]

components.example:
import { RadioGroup } from '@dangbt/pro-ui'

<RadioGroup
  label="Billing Cycle"
  options={[
    { value: 'monthly', label: 'Monthly', description: '$9/month' },
    { value: 'yearly', label: 'Yearly', description: '$90/year — save 17%' },
  ]}
  defaultValue="monthly"
/>

components.name: Switch
components.description: Toggle switch for boolean settings. Visually distinct from a checkbox.
components.example:
import { Switch } from '@dangbt/pro-ui'

<Switch defaultSelected>Email notifications</Switch>
<Switch isSelected={enabled} onChange={setEnabled}>
  Dark mode
</Switch>

components.name: Slider
components.description: Range slider with optional label and value output display.
components.example:
import { Slider } from '@dangbt/pro-ui'

<Slider label="Volume" defaultValue={70} />
<Slider label="Price range" minValue={0} maxValue={1000} step={10} defaultValue={200} />

components.name: DatePicker
components.description: Date picker with calendar popover. Also includes DateRangePicker for date ranges, DateField for inline editing, and standalone Calendar.
components.notes: Requires `@internationalized/date` for DateValue types. Import: `import { today, getLocalTimeZone } from "@internationalized/date"`

components.name: TimeField
components.description: Time input with segmented hour/minute/second editing.
components.example:
import { TimeField } from '@dangbt/pro-ui'

<TimeField label="Meeting time" />
<TimeField label="Closing time" hourCycle={24} />

components.name: TagGroup
components.description: Displays a list of tags with optional color variants and removal support.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: If provided, shows remove button on each tag

components.name: ToggleButton
components.description: Button that toggles on/off with selected state styling. ToggleButtonGroup manages single or multiple selection.
components.example:
import { ToggleButton, ToggleButtonGroup } from '@dangbt/pro-ui'
import { Grid, List } from 'lucide-react'

// Single toggle
<ToggleButton defaultSelected>Bold</ToggleButton>

// Group for view mode
<ToggleButtonGroup selectionMode="single" defaultSelectedKeys={['grid']}>
  <ToggleButton id="grid"><Grid size={16} /> Grid</ToggleButton>
  <ToggleButton id="list"><List size={16} /> List</ToggleButton>
</ToggleButtonGroup>

components.name: AsyncSelect
components.description: Select with server-side search and infinite scroll. Fetches options on demand via a fetch function.

props.name: fetchOptions
props.type: (params: { search: string; page: number; pageSize: number }) => Promise<{ options: T[]; hasMore: boolean }>

props.name: onChange
props.type: (value: string | null, option: T | null) => void

components.name: ComboBox
components.description: Editable select with typeahead filtering. User can type to filter options from a static list.

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Called when an option is selected

components.example:
import { ComboBox } from '@dangbt/pro-ui'

<ComboBox
  label="Country"
  placeholder="Search countries..."
  options={[
    { value: 'vn', label: 'Vietnam' },
    { value: 'us', label: 'United States' },
    { value: 'uk', label: 'United Kingdom' },
  ]}
/>

components.name: Autocomplete
components.description: Search field with a filtered suggestion list below. Items filter as the user types.

props.name: items
props.type: { id: string; label: string; description?: string }[]

components.example:
import { Autocomplete } from '@dangbt/pro-ui'

<Autocomplete
  label="Select framework"
  items={[
    { id: 'react', label: 'React', description: 'UI library by Meta' },
    { id: 'vue', label: 'Vue', description: 'Progressive framework' },
    { id: 'svelte', label: 'Svelte', description: 'Compiler framework' },
  ]}
/>

components.name: FileTrigger
components.description: Wraps a button/element to trigger a file picker dialog. Use alongside DropZone or a custom upload button.

components.name: DropZone
components.description: Drag-and-drop file upload zone with visual drop target feedback and click-to-browse fallback.

props.name: onFiles
props.description: Called with dropped or selected files

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables drag, click, and keyboard interaction

components.name: ColorPicker
components.import: ColorPicker, ColorSwatch, ColorSwatchPicker, ColorField, ColorArea, ColorWheel, ColorSlider
components.description: Full-featured color picker with color wheel, area, field, and swatch picker. Compose as needed.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled color value (use Color type from @dangbt/pro-ui)

components.notes: ColorPicker is a dialog trigger — wrap ColorArea/ColorWheel inside its popover. ColorSwatchPicker renders a grid of preset colors.
components.example:
import { ColorPicker, ColorSwatch, ColorSwatchPicker, ColorField } from '@dangbt/pro-ui'
import { DialogTrigger } from 'react-aria-components'

<ColorPicker defaultValue="#0ea5e9">
  <ColorSwatch size="md" />
</ColorPicker>

// Swatch picker with presets:
<ColorSwatchPicker
  defaultValue="#ef4444"
  onChange={(color) => console.log(color.toString('hex'))}
>
  {['#ef4444','#f97316','#eab308','#22c55e','#3b82f6','#8b5cf6'].map(c => (
    <ColorSwatch key={c} color={c} />
  ))}
</ColorSwatchPicker>

components.name: ProgressBar
components.description: Horizontal progress bar with value, label, and indeterminate mode for unknown durations.
components.example:
import { ProgressBar } from '@dangbt/pro-ui'

<ProgressBar label="Upload progress" value={65} showValue />
<ProgressBar variant="success" value={100} />
<ProgressBar isIndeterminate label="Processing..." />

components.name: Meter
components.description: Gauge bar for measured quantities like storage usage. Auto-colors from success→warning→danger based on percentage.

props.name: variant
props.description: Color variant. "auto" changes color based on percentage.

components.example:
import { Meter } from '@dangbt/pro-ui'

<Meter label="Storage used" value={73} maxValue={100} />
<Meter label="CPU" value={90} variant="danger" />

components.name: Breadcrumbs
components.description: Navigation breadcrumb trail with chevron separators and accessible current-page marking.
components.example:
import { Breadcrumbs } from '@dangbt/pro-ui'

<Breadcrumbs
  items={[
    { id: 'home', label: 'Home', href: '/' },
    { id: 'users', label: 'Users', href: '/users' },
    { id: 'current', label: 'John Doe' },
  ]}
/>

components.name: Disclosure
components.description: Collapsible panel with animated expand/collapse. Accordion groups multiple Disclosures with only one open at a time.
components.notes: Accordion wraps multiple Disclosure components and ensures only one is open. It passes no extra props beyond children.
components.example:
import { Disclosure, Accordion } from '@dangbt/pro-ui'

// Standalone
<Disclosure title="What is pro-ui?" defaultExpanded>
  A React component library built on React Aria and Tailwind CSS.
</Disclosure>

// FAQ accordion
<Accordion>
  <Disclosure title="How do I install?">
    Run npm install @dangbt/pro-ui.
  </Disclosure>
  <Disclosure title="Does it support dark mode?">
    Yes, via ThemeProvider with system/light/dark modes.
  </Disclosure>
</Accordion>

components.name: Link
components.description: Accessible anchor link with underline styling and color variants.
components.example:
import { Link } from '@dangbt/pro-ui'

<Link href="/dashboard">Go to Dashboard</Link>
<Link href="https://example.com" target="_blank" variant="muted">External link</Link>
<Link variant="danger" onPress={handleDelete}>Delete account</Link>

components.name: Divider
components.description: Horizontal or vertical separator line, optionally with a centered label.
components.example:
import { Divider } from '@dangbt/pro-ui'
Left Right

components.name: ListBox
components.description: Selectable list with optional sections, icons, descriptions, and single/multiple selection.

props.name: items
props.description: Flat list or sectioned list of options

components.example:
import { ListBox } from '@dangbt/pro-ui'
import { User, Settings, LogOut } from 'lucide-react'

<ListBox
  selectionMode="single"
  items={[
    { id: 'profile', label: 'Profile', icon: <User size={14} /> },
    { id: 'settings', label: 'Settings', icon: <Settings size={14} /> },
    { id: 'logout', label: 'Log out', icon: <LogOut size={14} />, description: 'Sign out of your account' },
  ]}
  onSelectionChange={(keys) => handleSelect(keys)}
/>

components.name: GridList
components.description: Interactive grid list with optional checkbox selection, icons, and descriptions. Good for multi-select UIs.

props.name: items
props.description: Items ({ id, label, description?, icon?, disabled? })

components.example:
import { GridList } from '@dangbt/pro-ui'

<GridList
  selectionMode="multiple"
  items={[
    { id: 'email', label: 'Email notifications', description: 'Get notified via email' },
    { id: 'sms', label: 'SMS notifications', description: 'Get notified via SMS' },
    { id: 'push', label: 'Push notifications', description: 'Browser push alerts' },
  ]}
/>

components.name: Tree
components.description: Hierarchical tree view with expandable nodes, optional icons, and selection support.

props.name: items
props.description: Tree nodes ({ id, label, icon?, children?: TreeNode[] })

props.name: defaultExpandedKeys
props.description: Keys of nodes expanded by default

components.example:
import { Tree } from '@dangbt/pro-ui'
import { Folder, File } from 'lucide-react'

<Tree
  selectionMode="single"
  items={[
    {
      id: 'src',
      label: 'src',
      icon: <Folder size={14} />,
      children: [
        { id: 'components', label: 'components', icon: <Folder size={14} /> },
        { id: 'app', label: 'app.tsx', icon: <File size={14} /> },
      ],
    },
    { id: 'package', label: 'package.json', icon: <File size={14} /> },
  ]}
/>

components.name: Toolbar
components.description: Container for a row of action buttons or controls, with keyboard navigation between items.
components.notes: Use ToolbarSeparator to add a visual vertical divider between groups of buttons.
components.example:
import { Toolbar, ToolbarSeparator, Button, ToggleButton } from '@dangbt/pro-ui'
import { Bold, Italic, Underline, AlignLeft, AlignCenter } from 'lucide-react'

<Toolbar>
  <ToggleButton size="sm"><Bold size={14} /></ToggleButton>
  <ToggleButton size="sm"><Italic size={14} /></ToggleButton>
  <ToggleButton size="sm"><Underline size={14} /></ToggleButton>
  <ToolbarSeparator />
  <ToggleButton size="sm"><AlignLeft size={14} /></ToggleButton>
  <ToggleButton size="sm"><AlignCenter size={14} /></ToggleButton>
</Toolbar>
